<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
<before>true</before>
<description/>
<name>Migrate Hidden Targets to Blocked Types</name>
<record_for_rollback>false</record_for_rollback>
<script><![CDATA[updateTargets();

function updateTargets(){
	var target = new GlideRecord('x_onpr_onpage_target');
	target.addQuery('hidden', true);
	target.query();
	while(target.next()){
		target.setValue('block_message_types', 'direct_reference,subscription');
		target.setValue('hidden', false);
		target.update();
	}
}]]></script>
